profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a London-based AI video platform that describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business. The company's platform allows users to create studio-quality videos using AI avatars and voiceovers across more than 160 languages without requiring cameras, microphones, actors, or physical studios. The site claims the platform is trusted by more than 90% of the Fortune 100 for internal communications, training, and employee upskilling, and that users can save up to 90% of time and cost on video production compared to traditional methods.

The core product, also called Synthesia, centers on AI avatar generation, with avatars described as speaking more than 160 languages with expressive delivery while remaining under the user's control. Additional features include AI voice generation, voice cloning, a screen recorder, a video translator, interactive avatars, and a PowerPoint-to-video converter. The platform integrates with existing Learning Management Systems for embedding videos directly into training courses, and it offers analytics such as view counts, drop-off rates, and completion rates. A free plan is available that includes 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and access to AI voices across the full language range. Synthesia states it is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant and labels AI-generated content in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

The site's held facts note the product carries likeness and consent risk, which is a recognized concern in the AI avatar space given the platform's ability to generate and clone human likenesses and voices. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
